body:
The 639Hz Frequency Bracelet is a wearable harmony tool—designed to work in resonance with the 639Hz Generator to help recalibrate your heart field, dissolve energetic friction, and restore flow within your daily life.

Associated with harmony, connection, and relationship repair, 639Hz is traditionally known for strengthening bonds—but at its core, it restores your relationship with yourself first. Your thoughts. Your reactions. Your nervous system. Your energy in motion.

When resistance builds internally, it shows up externally as tension, conflict, overthinking, and force. This bracelet is built to anchor coherence into your body so you can move through life with less push and more flow.

Each bead has been intentionally selected to support emotional intelligence, energetic balance, and heart-centered awareness—so you’re not just managing friction, you’re dissolving it at the frequency level.

This bracelet functions as a stabilizing ally, helping you:

  • Soften internal resistance and mental tension

  • Harmonize your emotional field and nervous system

  • Move through conversations and decisions with calm clarity

  • Strengthen self-connection and intuitive trust

When your inner world feels coherent, your outer world responds differently.

Benefits of Wearing This Frequency:

  • Encourages emotional balance and heart-field coherence

  • Reduces energetic friction in daily encounters and thought patterns

  • Supports self-acceptance, compassion, and internal harmony

  • Helps you respond instead of react

  • Aligns your field with the connective, unifying power of 639Hz

The Formula

Jadeite – A stone of peace, prosperity, and heart-centered wisdom. Encourages emotional equilibrium, gentle self-acceptance, and harmonious decision-making.

Blood Quartz – Strengthens the heart while grounding emotional intensity. Supports courage in vulnerability and stabilizes reactive patterns.

Peach Moonstone – A frequency of soft compassion and emotional flow. Calms overthinking, nurtures self-trust, and restores intuitive balance.

DZI Agate – A protective and harmonizing talisman stone. Shields the aura while balancing energetic exchanges and strengthening internal coherence.

Green Freshwater Pearls – Symbols of wisdom earned through experience. Encourage emotional refinement, grace under pressure, and fluid adaptability.

Together, this formula anchors the frequency of harmony into the body—helping you shift from force to flow, from friction to fluidity.

This is your wearable coherence tool—perfect for anyone feeling resistance in their thoughts, relationships with self, or daily life patterns, and for those working intentionally with the 639Hz Generator to stabilize the heart field.
